g.text: Founder persistence depends on world size and the observation horizon

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645c

g.text: Thin lines: five seeds per condition. Thick line: pointwise median. No confidence interval is shown.
Initial density: 5/64. Evolving: random founder traits + mutation. Neutral: all traits 250, no mutation.
Founder labels are ancestry identifiers, not species. No run in this campaign became extinct.
